basic_info.description: Opportunity doesn't knock often! Live the vibrant San Francisco lifestyle with this charming duplex at 630 Russia Avenue in the Excelsior neighborhood. Each spacious unit offers two bedrooms, abundant natural light, and a rare two-car side-by-side garage. Currently generating over $43,000 in annual rental income, this property is an excellent opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants.  Excelsior is a diverse, welcoming community known for its local parks, unique shops, and eclectic dining options. With quick access to BART, Muni, and major freeways, commuting to downtown San Francisco, Silicon Valley, or the Peninsula is convenient and straightforward.  Don't delay! Priced to sell quickly so please call your Broker/agent or call the listing office
